status: exploratory (post-PREREG revision analysis X2, P2-X; not pre-registered)

definitions.frac_empty: abstention rate = share of test incidents with no certified claim
definitions.abstain_split: share of splits whose lambda-hat is lambda_0 (no claims in any test incident)
definitions.fdr: mean per-incident strict FDP over test incidents, 0 for no claims (the estimand CRC-BH guarantees)
definitions.cond_fdp: CONDITIONAL FDP: mean strict FDP over test incidents with >= 1 claim (per split; mean over splits with >= 1 claimed incident)
definitions.cond_fdp_ratio: conditional FDP as a ratio over all splits: sum of FDPs / number of claimed test incidents (= mean FDR / (1 - mean abstention) when the test size is constant)
definitions.pooled_fdr: pooled FDR = sum V / max(sum R, 1) over a split's test incidents (share of issued claims that are false), mean over splits
definitions.n_false: mean false (Y != 1) claims per test incident
definitions.n_true_claims: mean true claims per test incident
definitions.n_claims_cond: mean claims per claimed test incident
definitions.n_false_cond: mean false claims per claimed incident
definitions.fdx_020: FDX exceedance P(FDP > 0.2) over test incidents
definitions.p_any_false: P(>= 1 false claim) per test incident
definitions.str_mean: STR = certified distinct transitions / |T*|, mean over incidents with |T*| > 0
definitions.recall_pooled: certified true links / true links in C (pooled)
definitions.dev_false_impl: non-campaign devices endpoint of >= 1 false claim / non-campaign devices (pooled)
definitions.ucr: share of certified links with a decoy endpoint (pooled)
definitions.maxchain_fdr: maximal-chain FDR (strict), mean over test incidents
definitions.cond_maxchain_fdp: mean maximal-chain FDP over test incidents with >= 1 reported chain
definitions.chain_exceed_a: share of test incidents whose maximal-chain FDP exceeds alpha
definitions.cond_chain_exceed_a: share of incidents with >= 1 chain whose maximal-chain FDP exceeds alpha
definitions.chain_fwer: P(some reported maximal chain is wrong)
definitions.frac_no_chain: share of test incidents with no reported chain

conventions: strict FDP (AMB counted false) unless *_lenient; split cells: 200 PREREG split seeds 0-199, PREREG K / test sizes; CI = incident-pool cluster bootstrap (B x 50 splits, P2-C stream); P-LOSO: window-level metrics, K = 22 scenarios, CI = scenario-cluster bootstrap with LOSO recomputation (bounded), jackknife as P2-G; Gotham-real: counts on 9 fixed incidents, no CI.
